description: DHC-2 'Beaver' (FDC 1.4, Rauw; Tjee & Mulder flight-test data): the modes and control steps at the thesis' trim point, and the flyable beaver-sim with the drivetrain and the FDC autopilot. Numbers come from design/design.json (an independent scipy implementation of the FDC model, validated against the thesis' Tables 5-1 and 5-3 and FDC's linear models).
